name: Landmine Press
instructions: Anchor one end of a barbell and stand facing it in a split or shoulder-width stance, holding the free end at your shoulder in one hand.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is extended.
Lower it under control to your shoulder.
Keep your core braced and avoid leaning back. Complete all reps, then switch sides.
image_prompt_scene: Standing with the end of a landmine bar held at the shoulder in one hand.
